newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TANNER TESTS POSITIVE FOR COCAINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TANNER TESTS POSITIVE FOR COCAINE.

text.p: A third English soccer player inside a year has tested positive for cocaine.
Adam Tanner, a 23-year-old defensive midfielder with Ipswich Town in the English first division, faces a lengthy ban after failing a random test at the club's training ground last month.
The Football Association (F.A.) has charged Tanner with misconduct and the player has been suspended pending a disciplinary enquiry.
"We've now carried out over 300 tests and this is the second test for cocaine we've had this season," said F.A. spokesman Steve Double.
"Cocaine is regarded as a performance-enhancing substance and it is a very serious matter."
Charlton teenager Jay Notley tested positive for cocaine, Ecstasy and cannabis in November, but because of his age was sent to a rehabilitation centre for assessment.
Orient's Roger Stanislaus was banned for a year last February and sacked by his club after also testing positive for cocaine.
